**Before filing:** update to the latest version, then open the app, click Change… next to Instances, and point it at the folder where your launcher keeps its instances. If your instances appear in the dropdown and you're able to sync with your templates, then there's likely no issue with your launcher.

If they don't appear, please provide:

 - Launcher name and version
 - Full path to the folder containing your instances
 - A text listing of one instance folder, top two levels only. In that folder run `tree /F /A` in Command Prompt, or paste a plain listing. A screenshot works if that's easier.
 - The message the app showed, if any

This is so I can support the launcher's directory format without downloading a copy of it.
